page_title: LOR 0-1 NAN | Lorient v Nantes 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
90+4' Julien Laporte (Lorient) commits a rough foul. Willy Delajod stops the game and makes a call.
90+1' Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Yvon Mvogo is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
90+1' Flag up against Tino Kadewere (Nantes). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) takes the corner with a short pass.
90' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Nantes get a corner.
87' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
84' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) is caught offside!
83' Regis Le Bris decides to make a substitution. Panos Katseris will be replaced by Gedeon Kalulu (Lorient).
83' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Jean-Kevin Duverne.
81' It doesn’t look good for Nicolas Cozza (Nantes); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
80' The game is interrupted now, Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
78' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
78' Tino Kadewere (Nantes) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball goes out of play. Nantes are awarded a corner kick.
77' Substitution. Mohamed Bamba did his best and is replaced by Eli Junior Kroupi (Lorient).
76' Bamba Dieng (Lorient) takes a short run up and tries to place the ball from the free kick, but the defensive wall blocks the effort.
75' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) trips an opposition player and Willy Delajod signals a foul. Lorient earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
74' A substitution has been made. Douglas Augusto is replaced by Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes).
71' The free kick from long range, taken by Lorient, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
70' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
70' Julien Ponceau (Lorient) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
69' Willy Delajod shows a yellow card to Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) for his blatant foul.
68' Jocelyn Gourvennec prepares a substitution. Moses Simon is replaced by Benie Traore (Nantes).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jean-Charles Castelletto trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marcus Coco (Nantes).
67' This is a yellow card! Douglas Augusto (Nantes) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
65' The corner is swung in but Lorient can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Lorient have been awarded a corner kick.
64' Substitution. Darlin Yongwa (Lorient) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Theo Le Bris walks off.
64' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Imran Louza and he is replaced by Aiyegun Tosin (Lorient).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ayman Kari departs the field of play to be replaced by Bamba Dieng (Lorient).
63' Julien Laporte (Lorient) is penalised for holding. Willy Delajod signals a set piece.
60' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

60' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nantes will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. The ball is behind the touchline and Nantes will take a throw-in.
56' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
54' Laurent Abergel (Lorient) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

52' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nantes.
49' 0 - 1 Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) slams a volley inside the left post from the edge of the box. Nice goal!
48' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Willy Delajod saw the whole situation.
46' Half-time substitution. Mostafa Mohamed is replaced by Tino Kadewere (Nantes).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Imran Louza (Lorient) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.

45+2' Panos Katseris (Lorient) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Now Lorient have a corner.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
45' Mohamed Bamba (Lorient) commits a rough challenge and Willy Delajod blows his whistle for a foul.
43' A cross into the box from Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Nantes will have a throw-in.
41' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
40' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
39' Panos Katseris (Lorient) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nantes.

34' Moses Simon (Nantes) shows off his individual ability with a jinking run into the box. Unfortunately, the finish lets him down as the ball flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lorient.
30' Yvon Mvogo leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Pedro Chirivella (Nantes).
29' Moussa Sissoko (Nantes) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nantes.

28' Isaak Toure (Lorient) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
28' Imran Louza (Lorient) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
28' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Lorient will take a corner kick.
26' Willy Delajod couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Eray Comert (Nantes) and blew his whistle.
24' Lorient are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
21' The referee blows his whistle after Ayman Kari (Lorient) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball.
19' Theo Le Bris (Lorient) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
17' Willy Delajod blows his whistle after Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
16' The corner from Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) is intercepted by the defence.

15' Moses Simon (Nantes) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Yvon Mvogo pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going inside the left-hand post. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nantes.
13' Pedro Chirivella (Nantes) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

13' Moses Simon (Nantes) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Yvon Mvogo is well positioned to make a comfortable save. The linesman makes the right call and Nantes will have a corner.
13' Nicolas Cozza (Nantes) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
11' That was close by Mohamed Bamba (Lorient)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
11' Willy Delajod blows his whistle and it's Moses Simon (Nantes) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
10' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) receives a lofted cross on the edge of the box and sends a shot to the middle of the goal. The goalkeeper had no trouble saving this one.
9' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The ball goes out of play and Lorient will have a goal kick.
6' Yvon Mvogo leaps to intercept the corner kick from Pedro Chirivella (Nantes).
5' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away. Good work from Nantes as they win a corner.
4' Lorient are happy showing off their ball keeping skills and that is only interrupted when the defender steps in. The ball has crossed the sideline. Lorient are taking a throw-in.
2' Willy Delajod has a clear sight and sees a foul from Douglas Augusto (Nantes).
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Nantes will kick-off.
Willy Delajod is introduced as the referee for today's match.
